description: Wait for an accessibility element to appear on screen. Polls until the element matching your criteria (label, role, or text) appears, or times out. Like Playwright's browser_wait_for.

label.description: Wait for element with this accessibility label (case-insensitive partial match)

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check in milliseconds (default: 500)

role.description: Wait for element with this role (e.g., "Button", "TextField", "StaticText")

text.description: Wait for element containing this text in label or value

name: simulator_wait_for_element
